summary: Allarity Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K on September 29, 2026, reporting under Item 8.01 that on September 28, 2026 it expanded its in-house medical laboratory to add proteomics and cell line research capabilities, supplementing existing transcriptomics and CLIA testing. The press release states these additions support mechanism-of-action work for lead candidate stenoparib (2X-121), a dual PARP/WNT inhibitor, and enable broader external research partnerships. No securities, ownership, pricing, transaction, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. This is an ordinary product/operations update, not a special situation.
